points: Read the mission before starting. Learn the controls, Run, Step and Oracle hints.
A new wallet starts with 20 coins. Each hint costs 6 coins; first clears award the configured rewards once.
Stage 2 is guided interface practice; the main flowchart lesson is Week 2.
lesson.title: Orientation

controls.summary: Drag flowchart symbols onto numbered positions and follow the arrows. Check chart executes every case. Arrow keys and Enter also place selected blocks.

objective: Read a rectangle's width and height. Calculate its area and display the result. Problem values 10, 5; test inputs [{'width': 10, 'height': 5}, {'width': 5, 'height': 6}, {'width': 0, 'height': 7}, {'width': 5, 'height': 8}, {'width': 10, 'height': 9}, {'width': 15, 'height': 10}, {'width': 10, 'height': 10}, {'width': 10, 'height': 5}].
title: Flowchart Lab · Rectangle area
subtitle: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
learning_objectives: Trace the direction of control flow.
Build a valid route from ordered nodes.
win_condition: Build and check a chart that produces the required outputs for every example input.
lose_condition: The run ends after the available unsuccessful chart checks are used.
hint: Trace the arrows. Read input before using it; use rectangles for assignments and diamonds for decisions.
